authority.scope: F1 only: A0R0 and A1R1 on three paired seeds

purpose: Test bounded sufficiency of successful-episode-stratified replay plus deterministic achieved-return preference relabeling for stable greedy Minecart ore behavior.

intervention.name: successful_episode_stratified_hindsight_preference_replay
intervention.eligibility: A completed episode is eligible iff its protocol-scaled discounted return is positive in at least one delivered-ore objective; partial episodes are never eligible.
intervention.finite_pool_projection: Minimum Euclidean distance to the frozen 32-point training pool; exact ties use ascending pool index.
intervention.success_draw: Choose an eligible trajectory uniformly, then a live generation-matched transition uniformly within that trajectory.
intervention.empty_stratum: All requested success positions fall back to uniform draws and are counted.
intervention.relabel_semantics: For eligible sampled transitions, use the projected episode label consistently for current prediction, next-action selection, and target evaluation; vector rewards and termination flags are immutable.
intervention.rng_streams: Both cells use common role-tagged SeedSequence seeds: exploration 4, action space 5, rollout preference 6; uniform replay uses the training seed, bootstrap/success/diagnostic streams use tags 1/2/3. Global NumPy/Python evaluation RNG is seeded independently and restored after each evaluation.
unchanged: masked Huber loss and active-head reduction
network, optimizer, target update, exploration, and bootstrap probability
training interactions, update count, replay capacity, and checkpoint cadence
validation preferences, episodes, seeds, reward scale, and reference point

qualification.failure_rule: If any A1R1 seed fails retention or the source/manipulation audit fails, stop after F1 and preserve the negative or inconclusive result. Do not run F2, lock checkpoints, or access final test.

resource_estimate.source: Measured Minecart v2 CPU runs on the same host and budget
resource_estimate.peak_memory_scope: Measured ru_maxrss during the 20-interaction, 17-update non-evidence A1R1 sanity run on this host; not a full-run upper bound.
resource_estimate.peak_memory_gate: Launch sanity gate satisfied; every full run must persist its own wall time, peak RSS, and checkpoint bytes.
